title: BYD SEALION 7 Europe: Three Trims, Three Choices
meta_description: Compare the European SEALION 7 launch versions by drivetrain, battery and charging, with separate Euro NCAP safety and Green NCAP evidence.
h1: BYD SEALION 7: The European Trim Choice Is More Than RWD Versus AWD
summary: Comfort, Design AWD and Excellence AWD represent different battery, drivetrain and charging combinations in BYD’s European launch table. The comparison keeps those combinations intact, then distinguishes crash-safety findings from the later environmental assessment of Comfort RWD.
diagram_alt: Original editorial diagram showing Comfort RWD, Design AWD, Excellence AWD. Not a vehicle photograph or scale drawing.
